projects.title: Map-Reduce App
projects.description:
•Implemented a map-reduce framework to support a variety of abstracted applications
•Designed and created inverted-index app for music lyrics

projects.title: Question Answering System
projects.description:
•Designed pipeline with named-entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging, passage creation, and passage similarity scoring 
•Scored passage similarity using TF-IDF to create term vectors that were compared by cosine similarity
•Answered simple questions (who/what/when/where/how many) with a mean reciprocal rank of 0.17
